about.title: About
about.lead: 9 years building systems where data has to be right
body: For 9+ years I have built systems for <hl>government agencies, universities and private companies</hl> — mostly where <hl>accuracy and auditability</hl> matter: finance, risk management, internal control, project planning and HR.

I start by understanding how people actually work, then design systems that are <hl>easy to maintain</hl> and connect cleanly to what an organisation already runs, such as ERP, workflow engines and e-signature.
about.lookingBody: A team building <hl>systems people actually use</hl> — especially <hl>backend</hl> work and bringing <hl>AI</hl> into systems where data has to be right. Full-time or project-based.
